same_species_task_comparison.task: Compare NOAA GML page and fixed raw table for 2023-2025, preserving both annual growth and uncertainty plus response receipts.

raw_capture_alignment.elapsed_between_raw_capture_times: approximately 16 minutes; sequential captures, not an atomic run

same_species_task_comparison.finding: The page/raw comparator reports 2023-2025 growth values equal in this observation and uncertainty differences of 0.004 ppt per year because the raw table prints 0.00. The raw-only lookup is sufficient when the task requests the raw table alone; it cannot supply the rendered page values or a paired comparison. The comparator uses one additional GET to supply the paired view.

portfolio_comparisons.reason: One fixed raw GET is sufficient for raw-table-only tasks; it cannot return a page/raw comparison or page uncertainty precision.
Fixed CO2 endpoints and ppm fields do not provide SF6 values.
Fixed methane endpoints and ppb fields do not provide SF6 values.
Fixed N2O endpoints and ppb fields do not provide SF6 values.

redundant_composition_observation.incremental_distinct_surface: none in this matched observation; the lookup repeated the raw surface already present in the comparator output
redundant_composition_observation.basis: Composed from two actual invocations captured 16 minutes apart; exact raw response digest and byte count match, but this is not one atomic sequential transaction.

portfolio_disposition.coexistence_reason: The comparator serves page/raw audit and precision-difference tasks. The raw-only lookup remains lower-request-count and sufficient when only the raw table is needed. Other-gas comparators cannot provide SF6 data.
portfolio_disposition.uncertainty: No comparative measurement accuracy, source reliability, long-run availability, or monetary cost ranking is established. Latency was not measured.
